category: Items Essential for Writing by Hand
explanation: Pen, Paper, Ink, and Correction Fluid are all directly used in the process of writing or correcting handwritten text. A Stapler is used for binding papers together after writing, not for the act of writing itself.

Charon (the ferryman), the River Styx, Tartarus (the abyss), and Cerberus (the guardian dog) are all integral components or figures of the Greek mythological underworld. Mount Olympus is the home of the Olympian gods, distinct from the underworld.
All verbs except 'Comply' are commonly followed by the preposition 'on'. 'Comply' is commonly followed by 'with'.
